text: Planning a trip can be exciting and a little stressful. First, you choose a destination and book your flights and hotel. When you arrive, you experience new cultures, which is often the best part of travelling. You can try local food, listen to different music, and learn about traditions. However, language barriers can sometimes make things difficult. You might not understand what people say, so you use gestures or a translation app. Despite these challenges, travel creates unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. Every journey teaches you something new about the world and yourself.
